section_summary.extract_value: This section provides clinical recommendations for professionals and caregivers to foster daughters' body appreciation and secure attachment through warm, consistent responses and by avoiding restrictive or critical messages about food and weight. Therapists are encouraged to use interventions (e.g., goal-setting to promote body appreciation, cognitive dissonance exercises, mirror work, role-plays, and promoting mindful eating) to help women respect and appreciate their bodies. The section does not reference or label any specific studies (no 'Study 1' or similar) and contains no methodological or sample details.
section_summary.evidence_source: Representative sentences: 'Professionals can help caregivers understand that the messages they send to their daughter about eating, weight, and relationships are linked to how she feels about herself and her body...' and 'Given the pivotal role of body appreciation in the model as well as the moderate-to-strong inverse link between discrepancy perfectionism and body appreciation, therapists are encouraged to incorporate interventions...' (section: 'Implications for Clinical Practice').
